intro: The Call of Water is an elemental rite of passage where shamans learn to commune with water spirits and wield their restorative powers. By retrieving a Shard of Water from Westfall for Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan, initiates prove their dedication and receive their water totem.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take shard. Take shard and give life.
Give life and understand. Understand water is life... Corruption stops life.
You protect and give life with water's power.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How fared your journey to Westfall? Success there is hard to measure, but even small victories carry weight.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Aye, this is the proof I asked for, and ye've done well, friend. I'm proud to be the first to offer my congratulations--and yer water totem. Use it wisely, and may fortune walk beside ye.
Yer next trial won't come soon, so take this time to learn. Pure water heals, aye, but its gifts go far beyond mending wounds.
